decision.rationale: Demander un essai d’intégration mesuré, sans présumer d’un gain : partir du meilleur programme correct, T2 32×16 (2,901 μs), et adapter le blocage de deux sorties y par thread de T3 (94ee21b6e9dd4f08, 2,976 μs). Hypothèse concrète : produire 32 lignes y par bloc avec 16 fils y, chacun calculant deux sorties, conserver un halo partagé de rayon 4 et viser 512 fils plutôt que le bloc 32×32 de 1024 fils essayé par 4bf3de724d1e4f6f (3,094 μs). Cela peut réduire le nombre de blocs et le surcoût des halos sans les blocs de 1024 fils, mais le surplus de ressources partagées et de travail par fil peut annuler le gain. Garder exactement les coefficients, l’arithmétique, la couverture de sortie et le repliement y période 63; vérifier l’oracle et mesurer la latence complète.

Terminer après l’intégration mesurée : le candidat combiné f42f92e86c6e4a1a est correct à 2,941 μs, mais plus lent que sa base correcte 264197d63c124b41 à 2,901 μs. Les résultats disponibles ne justifient pas une nouvelle combinaison; laisser le contrôleur retenir le meilleur programme vérifié et confirmer G indépendamment.

children.objective: Implement and measure a single-pass direct-global stencil with one output per thread and no shared memory or block-wide barriers. Map warp lanes to contiguous x elements; compare practical launch mappings and unroll the eight neighbor terms. Reproduce the baseline y-halo mapping for every offset, produce all 64³ outputs from current A on every call, and use no extra launch or allocation. Validate against the independent oracle and compare full-run event latency with the baseline.
children.subject: Coalesced direct-global stencil without shared memory

children.objective: Explore shared-memory pencil geometry as a contrast to the supplied 4-by-64 block. Compare wider x pencils while retaining the full 64-row y slab (for example, 8- or 16-wide x pencils) against x-wide blocks producing smaller y subtiles with radius-4 halos. Measure the tradeoff between improved x coalescing, block count, halo duplication, synchronization, and occupancy; do not assume either shape wins. Preserve the exact stencil coefficients and baseline y-halo/period-63 endpoint mapping, cover every output, validate against the independent oracle for varying signed inputs, and compare full-run event latency. Use only the existing buffers and allowed launch model.
children.subject: Shared-memory pencil geometry: full-height versus y-subtile tiling

children.objective: Implement and measure register-blocked y outputs: assign contiguous x elements across warp lanes and have each thread compute multiple nearby y outputs, reusing their overlapping input neighborhood in registers rather than shared memory. Explore a small number of outputs per thread and suitable launch geometry; preserve exact coefficients and baseline halo mapping, compute every output from current A, and use no additional allocation or launch. Compare oracle correctness and full-run latency.
children.subject: Register reuse across multiple y outputs
